title: Audio and music basics: waveforms to spectrograms
hook: Why a 6 kHz tone sampled at 10 kHz is heard at 4 kHz, what a longer frame buys and costs, and how ComfyUI turns seconds into audio latents.

verified.claim: EmptyLatentAudio's length is round((seconds x 44100 / 2048) / 2) x 2.
AudioOobleckVAE has strides multiplying to 2048 and a latent size of 64.
VAEDecodeAudio divides by max(1, 5 x std).
LogMelSpectrogram defaults to Hann, n_fft 2048, hop 512 and 128 mel bands.
Shannon's Theorem 1, Slaney's filterbank factor, and torchaudio's HTK default.
nm_audio validates and runs on a CPU.

unchecked: We did not run an audio VAE or a vocoder, so nothing here measures audio quality.
That ACE-Step 1.5 uses the 1920-ratio waveform VAE is our reading of EmptyAceStep1.5LatentAudio and the loader. We did not load its weights.
That a mel spectrogram loses phase follows from taking magnitudes. The lab doesn't test it.
Dips in the lab are for two equal tones and a Hann window only.
